stem: Which statement BEST explains the data shown in the graphs?

options.label: A
options.text: Hares with seasonal changes in fur color have a survival advantage and are more likely to successfully reproduce.

options.label: B
options.text: Hares change their fur color as a result of mating choice during the spring months.

options.label: C
options.text: Natural selection allows for mutations to occur during seasonal changes when food is abundant.

options.label: D
options.text: Hare fur color changes when sexual maturity occurs in the fall months.

visual_elements: Four line graphs showing Percentage of White Hares over Time and Snow Coverage over Time with dates and percentages.
